messages:
zoe_sales: Hey team — SeaBank (enterprise) just asked if we can onboard `marlin-13b-open` in apac (SG) and pin v1.2. They need quantized 4-bit variant and regional residency for PII-sensitive prompts. Any ETA? :eyes:
marta_product: Thanks Zoe — a few clarifying q's: 1) expected steady-state QPS / burst? 2) tail-latency SLO? 3) do they need Dedicated or is Hosted with geo-pin OK?
zoe_sales: They want predictable throughput (10 qps steady, 50 qps burst) and 95th <= 250ms. Prefer Dedicated but will consider Hosted if we guarantee region-only routing.
chris_infra: Quick notes: marlin-13b 4-bit quant usually runs on 80GB A100 pools with dynamic batching. For 10qps + 250ms SLO we should be fine on 2x A100-80 dims if KV cache hits are >50%. Need to verify model artifacts for 4-bit quant compatibility and licensing. Can you paste the source?
zoe_sales: Link to model tarball + license: https://storage.example/sea/marlin-13b-v1.2.tar.gz — license says Apache-2.0-compatible fork. Customer will share test prompt set once we sign MSA.
marta_product: OK — product asks for launch criteria before we move to backlog: - staging perf benchmark with their prompt set (95th <= 250ms at 10qps) - compatibility test for quantized variant (no generation regressions) - geo pin config & KMS key for logs - security review + QA checklist done
chris_infra: I'll run a quick perf smoke this afternoon. If quantization needs custom kernel tweaks, might add ~2 dev days. Also need to confirm Dedicated capacity slot vs hosted burst policy.
devex_bot: Intake form submitted: https://redwood.atlassian.com/INTAKE-4321 — please add required files and confirm billing tier.
onboard_bot: Intake accepted and ticket created: #ONB-2029. Assigned: unowned. Priority: P2.
marta_product: Proposal: move to product backlog under "APAC enterprise pinning" bucket and tag as customer-driven. Can someone assign an owner? Suggested acceptance criteria above.
zoe_sales: SeaBank agrees to acceptance criteria. They'll provide the prompt set by EOD tomorrow and need a pilot in SG by next month. :calendar:
marta_product: Cool — I'll take ownership of the product-side rollout and coordinate infra. @chris_infra can you confirm perf results by EOD so we can estimate effort and set schedule? :thumbsup:
chris_infra: On it — will post perf numbers and any blocker comments in the intake ticket.
